title: Practice 4: Actions and their results: nouns from verbs

blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.why: **де́лание** — doing, making. Source: Wiktionary, «-ание» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ание#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there.
**жела́ние** — wish, desire. Source: Wiktionary, «-ание» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ание#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there.
**желание** — жела́ние: wish, desire; wanting, volition, tending. Wiktionary: жела́ть + -а́ние.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **писа́ние** — writing, script, scripture. Source: Wiktionary, «-ание» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ание#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there.

exercises.q: Where is this mentioned in the scriptures?
exercises.why: **писаниях** — писа́ние: writing, script, scripture. Wiktionary: писа́ть + -а́ние.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **молча́ние** — silence (action or state of remaining silent; that is, abstention from speech, utterances, or the use of the voice). Source: Wiktionary, «-ание» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ание#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there.
**молчание** — молча́ние: silence (action or state of remaining silent; that is, abstention from speech, utterances, or the use of the voice). Wiktionary: молча́ть + -а́ние.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **ожида́ние** — expectation, waiting, pending. Source: Wiktionary, «-ание» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ание#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: сказа́ние — legend; saga; story; де́лание — doing, making; жела́ние — wish, desire; писа́ние — writing, script, scripture.
**ожидания** — ожида́ние: expectation, waiting, pending. Wiktionary: ожида́ть + -а́ние.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **зва́ние** — title, rank, status (indicating qualifications, official recognition, etc.). Source: Wiktionary, «-ание» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ание#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there.
**звании** — зва́ние: title, rank, status (indicating qualifications, official recognition, etc.); (military) rank. Wiktionary: звать + -а́ние.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.
